title: Themify Base WordPress theme through 1.2.4 does not perform capability checks on its option save and read AJAX…
description: The Themify Base WordPress theme up to version 1.2.4 lacks proper capability checks on its option save and read AJAX actions. These actions rely solely on a generic nonce commonly exposed on the front end, allowing users with minimal roles such as Subscriber to modify critical blog options. This includes changing the default user role and enabling open registration, which can lead to privilege escalation and unauthorized administrator access.
